Islands & water

Crossing to Cingkuak Island

Boats to Cingkuak Island leave from the Pantai Carocok jetty, but availability, fare, and safety are strongly set by the day. This page helps preparation without promising a schedule.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Booking

At the jetty, not online

Crossings are generally arranged at the beach jetty, not online booking. Ask the operator about fare, capacity, and departure time before boarding.

  • Confirm the boat fare before boarding.
  • Ask about capacity and life jackets.
  • Note the operator name for complaints if needed.

Safety

Check before boarding

Ensure the boat has life jackets and valid operating permission. Do not board in bad weather or when staff restrict it.

Weather decides

Crossings can be cancelled due to waves or weather. Prepare a land-based backup if unavailable.

Cost

Separate fare

The boat fare is paid separately to the operator, not to the beach gate retribution. Because fares change, do not rely on outdated figures.

Questions

Before you go

01What is the boat fare to Cingkuak?+

The fare is paid separately to the operator and can change. Confirm before boarding; we do not list a fixed number.

02Can I book online?+

Crossings are generally arranged at the jetty, not online booking. Ask the operator on site.

03Safe for children?+

Ensure life jackets are available and the crew respects weather limits. Supervise children at all times.

04If the boat is cancelled?+

Crossings can be cancelled due to weather. Use a backup plan such as walking, photos, or eating in Painan.
